canonical_source.behavior: The authorized Pages Explorer toolbar exposes a navigation-only Posts control to /module/posts under the ContentView policy. The control performs no mutation, persistence, queue, WordPress, connector, provider, or secret operation.

laravel_adaptation.behavior: The real Pages production route renders the Posts link only when authoritative FrontendContext proves tenant access, content.view, the Posts API contract, a connected connector advertising posts.read, and an enabled Posts capability. The destination is derived only from context.tenant.slug through tenantUrl and the canonical workspace route; no caller-supplied tenant or resource identifier is accepted.

authorization.security_result: The control grants no authority. It is hidden unless the server-provided context proves tenant access and the existing Posts workspace permission/API/connector/capability contract.

tenant_isolation.proof: Focused acceptance proves tenantUrl encodes tenant-shaped path fragments and cannot convert alpha/../foreign into the foreign tenant route. Foreign-tenant navigation therefore remains behind the server tenant-resolution 404 boundary.

semantics.authoritative_reread: FrontendContext permission/API/connector/capability contract is authoritative for visibility
semantics.wordpress_runtime: no WordPress request is executed by this control
semantics.connector_runtime: connector state is read only as a fail-closed availability gate; the control invokes no connector action

degraded_and_failure_semantics.failure_claim: No success state or mutation result is fabricated because this operation only exposes navigation when its authoritative route contract is enabled.

coverage: exact canonical operation marker and source-equivalent Posts label
foreign-tenant path injection remains outside the foreign route and behind the server 404 isolation boundary
fail-closed visibility without the authoritative Posts API contract
fail-closed visibility without a connected connector advertising posts.read
fail-closed visibility when the server disables the Posts capability

canonical_denominator.note: Counts describe exactly this isolated one-operation contribution against the live generated reconciliation authority. Parallel unmerged work is not folded into these counts.

terminality.basis: Real source-equivalent navigation is implemented on the production Pages route, derives tenant scope only from authoritative context, fails closed on missing RBAC/API/connector/capability proof, is deterministically focused-tested including foreign-tenant isolation, and introduces no mutation or privileged runtime surface. Final canonical credit remains conditional on official exact-SHA generator reconciliation and repository gates.
